single_variable: Does contemporaneous ETH/BTC relative information matter? Keep corrected 360 OKX names, 1,570 funded native parents and the same fixed contrarian 1x/2x size rule. Apply it to a 30-day ETH/BTC return ending 30, 60 or 90 days before each entry, instead of the actual current 30-day window. These disjoint, fully causal placebo features retain trending regime persistence. Keep original trade priority, stops, sizes capped at 20%, costs and 5bp stress. Compare with already frozen current-window and uniform outcomes; exploratory, not an unseen holdout.
